row.team_price_text: Organization: $399/mo flat, billed annually (up to 500 members)
row.evidence: Disco's SAML SSO help article says "Disco does not currently support SCIM. User provisioning happens through Just-in-Time provisioning on first SSO login, or by inviting users from the Admin Console."
row.notes: Researched as Disco (disco.co), the AI learning/academy platform; the candidate name is ambiguous with CS DISCO (csdisco.com, legal ediscovery), whose public help centre also returns no SCIM articles and offers SAML/OIDC SSO set up by DISCO support. No SCIM: JIT on SAML login (Enterprise only) plus admin invites and CSV bulk import. Flat pricing: Organization $399/mo billed annually for up to 500 members; Enterprise is custom and adds SAML SSO, the REST API and webhooks (both Enterprise-only), so per-user fields are null.

plans.name: Organization
plans.notes: Flat price; SAML SSO, API and webhooks are listed as Enterprise additions.

limitations.text: Without SCIM, a user disabled in the IdP keeps Disco access until their SSO session ends.

capabilities.notes: update_user only changes external_user_id; delete = remove from the community. The API docs also list adding/removing Admins or Managers, but those endpoints were not mapped here.

endpoints.purpose: Create a user and add to the community
Remove a user from the community

webhooks_user_events.notes: Enterprise only; events are about learning activity (joins, completions, submissions).

rate_limits.text: Per endpoint and per Academy; most user and group endpoints 100 requests/minute (some 50 or 30).

limitations.text: API style is RPC-like (all POST, e.g. /v1/user.create) rather than resource REST.

okta.notes: Okta catalogue search for 'disco' returned no Disco app; Disco's guide has the admin create a SAML app in the IdP.
